title: Nvidia's Q3 numbers were pretty good. Its earnings call optics were another story.
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi runs down Nvidia's (NVDA) third quarter earnings call, wondering why analysts didn't ask questions about former CEO Jensen Huang and how the company handled the call.

title: Nvidia earnings special coverage: "The street wants to believe in Nvidia after Jensen"
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi covers the first Nvidia earnings call post-Jensen Huang. He covers what he heard about their search for a new CEO and talent retention after the scandal. As well as what he thinks the streets are expecting of Nvidia in this new era.

title: Nvidia with a positive Q3 despite SEC probing Nvidia amid Huang Scandal
summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Jensen Huang's statement that he would be willing to return, the SEC's post-scandal probe into Nvidia (NVDA), and Nvidia's positive earnings report. 

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft's (MSFT) AI chief, to discuss Microsoft's 6 new AI models, the AI competition, and the 'handoverism' worldview.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

title: Nvidia interim-CEO Colette Kress speaks on quarterly revenue hitting $116B
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) interim CEO Colette Kress spoke about the company's third quarter earnings report, which recorded revenue of $116 billion, more than doubling year over year, and raised its fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook.

title: Nvidia chair says board 'does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO'
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) board Chairman Harvey Jones said on the company's third quarter earnings call that it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, a week after he resigned from the post following "personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct."

title: AMD, Broadcom, CoreWeave stocks rise on Nvidia earnings beat
summary: Semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks moved higher in after-hours trading on Tuesday after AI chip heavyweight Nvidia posted better-than-expected quarterly results.

title: Nvidia earnings: Why Jensen turmoil won't have a near-term impact on the numbers
summary: Uniphore CEO Umesh Sachdev and Morningstar equity strategist Brian Colello sit down with Deirdre Bosa to share their thoughts on Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings results in the wake of Jensen Huang's departure from the company.

title: Nvidia’s Q3 earnings show its advantage as the bank of the AI boom
summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa explains that Nvidia's (NVDA) role as a quasi-lender to smaller neo cloud customers means that part of its sales depends on customers it helps finance, which shows up in receivables and free cash flow.

title: Why a Jensen Huang comeback could become a major battle in Washington
summary: Semafor's editor in chief, Ben Smith, sits down with Deirdre Bosa to explain why Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia (NVDA) would be so contentious among politicians in Washington.

title: What to make of Jensen Huang's apology letter
summary: Deirdre Bosa outlines what former Jensen Huang had to say in his apology letter posted on X, just hours before Nvidia's (NVDA) third quarter earnings results.
